name: Voice-to-Text Dictation Layer with Glaido
summary: Uses Glaido system-wide voice-to-text dictation overlay to dictate high-velocity prompts without typing bottlenecks.
steps: Install Glaido desktop dictation app.
Activate Glaido hotkey over Claude Code or Codex text input.
Dictate long, structured prompts naturally at speaking pace.
Submit dictated text directly to the AI agent.
jarvis_use: Enable system-wide voice dictation overlay to rapidly input complex prompts into coding agents.

name: Multi-Agent Parallel Market Research Scraping
summary: Launches 5 parallel research sub-agents across YouTube, Skool, Twitter, Reddit, and web scraping sources to isolate customer pain points.
steps: Prompt Claude Code to act as a research orchestrator.
Configure connected data tools (YouTube API, Skool API, Twitter API, Firecrawl, Perplexity API).
Spawn 5 parallel sub-agents to scan online communities and threads (~60,000 items).
Consolidate scraped findings into categorized market pain points and recommended product concepts.
jarvis_use: Scrape online forums and social communities in parallel to validate customer pain points before development.

name: Reddit Price Sensitivity Extraction & Consensus Mining
summary: Extracts pricing sentiment quotes from scraped Reddit thread data to establish target subscription bands ($25–$50/mo).
steps: Instruct research sub-agent to filter scraped Reddit comments for pricing keywords.
Extract price-related sentence quotes and willingness-to-pay signals.
Identify pricing consensus bands (e.g. single-purpose time-saving tools command $25–$50/mo).
Adjust SaaS product tier pricing to match community pricing expectations.
jarvis_use: Mine Reddit comment datasets for explicit pricing quotes to establish competitive SaaS subscription tiers.

name: Visual Brand Identity Generation in Codex with GPT Image 2
summary: Generates brand names, visual logos, and color palettes using GPT Image 2 inside Codex.
steps: Prompt Codex with target buyer persona, style criteria (consultancy grade, no red), and product domain.
Codex runs naming collision checks against existing market products.
Generate visual logo mark variants and color schemes using GPT Image 2.
Select winning brand territory (e.g. 'Editorial Fold' navy/cream/teal theme).
jarvis_use: Generate clean visual brand assets and color palettes inside Codex for new software projects.

name: Simulated Buyer Persona Brand Validation Sweep
summary: Simulates multiple buyer personas in Codex to evaluate brand names, visual logos, and messaging clarity before launch.
steps: Prompt Codex to spin up 4 distinct buyer personas (Business Owner, Agency Owner, Small Business Owner, CEO).
Provide personas with proposed brand logo, name, and headline copy.
Collect first-impression feedback and trust ratings from each persona.
Refine value proposition copy and taglines based on persona consensus.
jarvis_use: Simulate multi-persona buyer panels to evaluate product branding and messaging before going to market.

name: Session Handoff & Context Reset Protocol
summary: Executes `/session-handoff` to summarize context and `/clear` to reset context windows while preserving build progress.
steps: Execute `/session-handoff` command to generate a structured markdown summary of progress, decisions, and key files.
Copy the handoff summary block to system clipboard.
Run `/clear` command to wipe active session memory and reset token limits.
Paste handoff block into a new session to resume development without context rot.
jarvis_use: Maintain multi-step agent build quality by periodically summarizing progress, clearing context, and reloading handoffs.

name: Orchestrated Build Planning with Fable 5 (`BUILD-PLAN.md`)
summary: Instructs a high-reasoning orchestrator model (Fable 5) to compile a structured `BUILD-PLAN.md` file dividing software development into isolated workstreams.
steps: Set Claude Code model to Fable 5 (High Reasoning).
Dictate product vision, slide specs, tech stack (Next.js, Supabase, Stripe), and user flow.
Instruct Fable 5 to write `BUILD-PLAN.md` covering architecture, schemas, and workstreams (Phase 0 to Phase 2).
Ensure build plan categorizes tasks into non-overlapping parallel worktrees.
jarvis_use: Create detailed markdown build plans that divide complex software architectures into isolated sub-agent tasks.

name: Automated Waitlist Landing Page Creation in Goal Mode
summary: Generates a complete Next.js waitlist landing page with brand guidelines and form capture using `/goal` mode in Codex.
steps: Activate `/goal` mode in Codex.
Prompt Codex with brand colors, logo, headline promise, and email capture requirements.
Codex scaffolds Next.js landing page with responsive desktop/mobile layouts.
Codex verifies lead capture API persistence in local storage/database.
jarvis_use: Generate responsive waitlist landing pages with lead capture APIs using goal-mode autonomous agents.

name: Password-Protected Waitlist Admin Dashboard (`/admin/waitlist`)
summary: Builds a protected admin dashboard (`/admin/waitlist`) for lead signups inspection, metrics tracking, and CSV exports.
steps: Prompt Codex to build a secure admin route `/admin/waitlist`.
Add password protection or session auth to admin routes.
Render analytics cards (Total signups, 24h signups, 7d signups) and contact tables.
Include a CSV download button to export collected lead email addresses.
jarvis_use: Build password-protected admin dashboards to view and export captured lead database records.

name: Mandatory Verification Loop Prompting for Agent Forms
summary: Enforces mandatory verification loops in agent goal prompts to ensure form submissions, UI clicks, and database persistence pass automated checks.
steps: Include explicit verification criteria in goal prompt ('Don't stop until you've validated it').
Require agent to open embedded browser and test form submissions with valid/invalid inputs.
Instruct agent to verify backend database storage and capture browser screenshots.
Reject task completion until all verification checks return PASS.
jarvis_use: Prevent untested code output by forcing agents to run automated browser submission and verification checks.

name: Multi-Agent Delegation Across Isolated Git Worktrees
summary: Spawns parallel worker sub-agents (Opus/Sonnet) across isolated git worktrees managed by a Fable 5 orchestrator to prevent code collisions.
steps: Instruct Fable 5 orchestrator to manage full-stack build execution.
Create isolated git worktree directories corresponding to distinct workstreams (Auth, API, UI, PDF, Billing).
Spawn worker sub-agents (Opus/Sonnet) assigned to specific worktree directories.
Monitor worker transcripts and automatically merge verified worktrees to main branch.
jarvis_use: Isolate parallel coding sub-agents into separate git worktrees to execute modular features without file merge conflicts.

name: Mobile Session Management via Claude Code Remote Control
summary: Monitors, manages, and prompts long-running CLI coding agent sessions remotely from a mobile browser.
steps: Enable Remote Control in Claude Code CLI/Desktop app (`Remote Control [On]`).
Open the generated session web URL on a mobile device.
View live execution logs, agent background tasks, and terminal outputs.
Issue new prompts or answer agent approval requests remotely away from desk.
jarvis_use: Monitor and manage long-running local background agent builds from a mobile phone.

name: Screenshot-Based Deployment Error Diagnosis
summary: Pastes error screenshots (e.g. Vercel 404 NOT_FOUND) into Codex to automatically diagnose build setting errors and fix deployment configuration.
steps: Capture a screenshot of a deployment failure or HTTP error page (e.g., 404 NOT_FOUND).
Paste image screenshot into Codex prompt with deployment context.
Codex inspects build configuration files and framework presets (e.g. Vite vs Next.js).
Codex applies configuration fixes and triggers automated redeployment.
jarvis_use: Diagnose deployment errors and broken build configurations by analyzing screenshots of error screens.

name: Computer Use Autonomous Application & Boundary QA
summary: Passes local or staging web app URLs to Codex computer use in an embedded browser to autonomously perform edge-case QA and output bug reports.
steps: Provide Codex with target app URL (e.g., `http://localhost:3010`).
Prompt Codex to use computer use to click every button, fill form fields, upload files, and attempt boundary violations.
Codex controls mouse and keyboard in embedded browser, exploring UI routes and capturing errors.
Codex categorizes findings into Launch Blockers, High-Priority, and Medium-Priority bug reports.
jarvis_use: Autonomously stress-test web applications and discover boundary bugs using browser computer use.

name: Automated Form Input Validation Catching & Self-Correction
summary: Detects form validation errors during computer use QA (e.g. invalid color string) and automatically self-corrects input formatting.
steps: Agent attempts form entry during browser interaction (e.g. enters string 'RED' into hex color field).
Agent catches validation error prompt ('Accent color needs to be a valid hex value').
Agent reformats input to compliant structure (e.g. `#2E756D`).
Agent resubmits form and verifies save confirmation.
jarvis_use: Self-correct invalid form inputs during automated browser UI testing upon catching validation errors.

name: Uninterrupted Querying via `/btw` Side-Chat Command
summary: Uses the `/btw` side-chat command in Claude Code to ask side questions without breaking the active agent task or orchestrator reasoning chain.
steps: Identify a side query needed while main agent task is thinking (e.g. asking which auth backend is planned).
Prefix prompt with `/btw` command in Claude Code terminal.
Review side-chat response without interrupting primary build execution.
Close side-chat window and allow orchestrator task to continue seamlessly.
jarvis_use: Ask side architectural questions during long agent execution runs using non-disruptive side-chat commands.

name: Clipboard-Driven Schema Migration via Supabase SQL Editor
summary: Generates database migration SQL in Claude Code, copies DDL script to system clipboard, and runs it inside Supabase SQL Editor.
steps: Claude Code compiles full relational DDL script (tables, foreign keys, RLS policies).
Claude Code automatically copies SQL script to system clipboard.
Open Supabase Console -> SQL Editor, paste clipboard contents, and execute script.
Verify in Table Editor that all relational tables are correctly created.
jarvis_use: Initialize relational database tables in Supabase by generating and executing AI-written SQL migrations.

name: Stripe Sandbox Integration & Local Testing
summary: Configures Stripe Sandbox API keys in `.env.local` to safely test subscription tiers, hosted checkout, and webhook handlers before going live.
steps: Create Stripe Sandbox test account and create recurring monthly/annual products ($39/mo, $390/yr).
Retrieve publishable (`pk_test_...`) and secret (`sk_test_...`) sandbox keys.
Populate keys into local `.env.local` configuration.
Test signup flow with test card numbers (`4242...`), verifying webhook delivery and active plan unlocking.
jarvis_use: Safely test subscription billing flows and webhook event handlers using Stripe Sandbox environments.

name: Prompt IP & Experience-Based Moat Strategy
summary: Bakes domain-specific heuristics, founder insights, and interview knowledge into system prompts to create software defensibility beyond UI features.
steps: Run structured grill/interview sessions to capture domain expertise, edge cases, and frameworks.
Incorporate captured domain knowledge directly into backend system prompts.
Ensure core AI generation engines reframe problems, compute ROI math, and generate tailored deliverables.
Focus product defensibility on proprietary prompt IP and accumulated proof rather than easily cloned UIs.
jarvis_use: Enhance product moat by embedding deep domain expertise into backend generation system prompts.

name: OWASP ASVS Automated Security Audit against Reference Repos
summary: Audits codebase against OWASP ASVS 5.0 Level 1 security standards by feeding reference documentation into Codex to catch vulnerability release blockers.
steps: Provide Codex with target application codebase and reference link (`OWASP/CheatSheetSeries`).
Prompt Codex to audit auth, multi-tenant isolation, cross-tenant leaks, SQL injection, and SSRF vulnerabilities.
Codex executes automated multi-tenant security attacks and identifies release blockers.
Prompt Codex in `/goal` mode to orchestrate fix agents, remediate vulnerabilities, and re-test.
jarvis_use: Audit application codebases against OWASP security benchmarks to patch cross-tenant leaks and vulnerabilities.

name: Automated Vercel CLI Deployment & Environment Sync
summary: Uses Vercel CLI OAUTH authentication inside Claude Code to automate project linking, environment variable sync, and deployments.
steps: Run `vercel login` CLI command inside Claude Code and complete browser OAUTH flow.
Claude Code links local repository to Vercel production project.
Claude Code extracts keys from `.env.local` and injects them into Vercel Project Settings via CLI.
Trigger production deployment build and confirm custom domain binding.
jarvis_use: Automate cloud infrastructure linking, environment variable sync, and deployments via CLI commands.

name: Canonical Hostname CSRF Recovery for Production Custom Domains
summary: Diagnoses and fixes production login failures caused by middleware host mismatches between default deployment URLs and custom domain names.
steps: Identify production CSRF login failures after attaching custom domain (`getclientpack.com`).
Inspect server logs to trace request halts inside security middleware.
Detect mismatch between `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` (configured to default `.vercel.app`) and canonical custom domain.
Update `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` in Vercel environment variables to `https://www.getclientpack.com` and redeploy.
jarvis_use: Fix cross-site request login errors by updating environment variables to match production custom domains.

name: Watermark-Gated Freemium Product Trial Strategy
summary: Structures SaaS pricing to deliver 1 free output with a watermark badge while gating watermark removal and unlimited usage behind paid recurring tiers.
steps: Identify the exact user 'aha moment' (e.g. generating 1 full proposal deck from discovery call transcripts).
Provide 1 free generation containing a discrete brand watermark without asking for payment details.
Gate watermark-free PDF exports and additional project decks behind paid subscription tiers ($39/mo, $390/yr).
Integrate hosted Stripe checkout and billing portal for self-serve upgrades and cancellations.
jarvis_use: Implement watermarked trial gates on digital asset generators to convert users after initial value delivery.

name: Micro-Creator Sponsorship Distribution Strategy
summary: Sponsors niche micro-creators ($250–$500) with warm, engaged audiences for early customer acquisition instead of spending on un-optimized cold ad campaigns.
steps: Identify micro-creators whose audience matches the target SaaS buyer persona.
Provide creators with free pro accounts and demonstrate core value proposition.
Pay creators small fixed sponsorship fees ($250–$500) plus affiliate performance bonuses for sales.
Track conversion performance across custom creator links.
Re-invest in top-performing creator hooks and whitelist high-performing organic posts into paid ad campaigns.
jarvis_use: Acquire initial SaaS users by sponsoring micro-creators with engaged niche communities.
